description: Expander for Custom Blank, placed immediately to its left, giving clock control of the GIF animation and triggers out as it runs.

params.text: Steps the clock mode through Sync, synchronising the animation to a steady clock; Scan, where 0-10V picks the frame from first to last; and Frame, one frame advanced per clock.
Returns the animation to its first frame.
Sets which frame counts as the first one for the reset input, the end-of-animation output and the ping pong turning point.
Loads the next slideshow file, in the order chosen in Custom Blank's own menu.

inputs.text: Drives the animation in the way the clock mode sets: a steady clock to synchronise to, a 0-10V scan across the frames, or one frame advanced per trigger.
A trigger returns the animation to its first frame.
A trigger loads the next slideshow file, in the order chosen in Custom Blank's own menu.

outputs.text: Sends a trigger each time the animation restarts.
Sends a trigger each time the frame changes.

notes: the expander does nothing unless a Custom Blank is the module immediately to its right, and that Custom Blank has an animated GIF loaded.
menu: Sync, Scan and Frame Advance — on the clock mode switch's own right-click menu rather than the module's, each with a line saying what that mode does.

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
